_comment: Copy to config.json. The scripts read this and voice-profile.json. Almost everything here should come from your own archive rather than from these defaults — run scripts/voice_profile.py first.
_site_url: Drives internal-vs-external link classification in the linter. Get it wrong and every one of your own links counts as external.
_corpus_dir: A markdown crawl of your blog. Screaming Frog exports fine. Same corpus the topic-cluster-audit workflow uses.

lint._spelling: us | uk. voice_profile.py tells you which one your archive actually uses — that answer is sometimes a surprise.
lint._dash: spaced_en | em | any. Pick the one your archive already uses; the profiler reports the split.
lint._banned_patterns: Your own deprecated terms and legacy tics. This list is where a postmortem becomes a rule — add one every time something embarrassing nearly ships.
lint._word_bands: Per content type, derived from your own archive rather than guessed. voice_profile.py prints p10/median/p90.
lint._links: Norms, not laws. A product-led page with zero external links can be correct — that is exactly the kind of warning that survives with a written reason.
